subject: effect on density estimate of the choice of truncation distance in PXDA HDS and

messages.author: caaac2dc0aae28b8
messages.subject: effect on density estimate of the choice of truncation distance in PXDA HDS and
parts: In the PXDA version of hierarchical distance sampling described in AHME Vol1. section 8.5.2 pages 445-452,the parameter B is what determines the area used in the denominator for the density calculation. In the text example B is the strip half-width used to simulate the data, but I think in general this should be either the maximum distance observed or to which data are truncated)   My question is, how sensitive will the resulting density estimate be to how this truncation distance is chosen? Also, am I correct that if there is no truncation of distances, this parameter should equal the maximum distance observed? The reason for my interest is that the resulting density estimate will be very sensitive to how B is determined.
